wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Lead Times"]

cell = ws["B5"]
old_formula = cell.value

# Preserve any lead-time values/ranges already present in the existing formula,
# and wrap each WORKDAY(...) result in TEXT(...,"mm/dd/yyyy") so TEXTJOIN returns dates, not serials.
if isinstance(old_formula, str) and old_formula.startswith("=") and "WORKDAY(" in old_formula:
    if "TEXT(WORKDAY(" not in old_formula:
        new_formula = re.sub(
            r'(?<!TEXT\()WORKDAY\(([^()]*)\)',
            r'TEXT(WORKDAY(\1),"mm/dd/yyyy")',
            old_formula
        )
    else:
        new_formula = old_formula
else:
    # Fallback matching the requested formula, with the required stored prefix for TEXTJOIN.
    new_formula = '=_xlfn.TEXTJOIN("-",,TEXT(WORKDAY(B4,10,K14:K20),"mm/dd/yyyy"),TEXT(WORKDAY(B4,12,K14:K20),"mm/dd/yyyy"))'

# Ensure modern TEXTJOIN retains the stored _xlfn. prefix if needed.
if new_formula.startswith("=TEXTJOIN("):
    new_formula = "=_xlfn." + new_formula[1:]

cell.value = new_formula

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)

v = check_ws["B5"].value
